body.p: How the Mbukushu killed the Khwe man Fwεrε.

When the Khwe had settled down and lived at Wε-dom, the Mbukushu decided to go to the Khwe, [saying] "we will kill them". They came to the Khwe
who had settled down and were living at Wε-dom. Then [the Mbukushu] Diwe, Bove-bo-bove and his grandson Kadhimo came to kill the Khwe man Fwεrεunder a small shiwi tree. Then they returned to their homestead. Thus the Mbukushu went to [our] land and killed a Khwe man. Thus Kafuro has told the truth to me, Ndo.
